name: manual_2a1bbf
claim: Before pushing to a shared PR branch, git fetch and diff origin/<branch>..HEAD first -- another agent can commit directly into the same physical worktree path across sessions with no board signal until a later digest post, so a local HEAD commit is provisional until verified against the remote tip, not assumed to be yours alone.

decisions.notes: agent-envelope: agent=claude-main model=claude-sonnet-5 date=2026-09-17 | Discovered mid-task on orama-system PR#360 (docs/ossf-publication-plan-20260916): my own worktree at /private<local-tmp-file> had 3 unexpected commits (39efcd3e, 4754377b, 63f137ef) from cursor-composer-ossf-draft on top of my original 11b98cff, discovered only via git log inspection, not any board push notification. Fetch+diff caught it before an accidental force-push or duplicate-work situation.
